scripts.api:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply sky-defender --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.api:errors: wrangler d1 execute sky-defender --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT datetime(last_seen / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS last, count, version, platform, message, substr(stack, 1, 300) AS stack FROM errors ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.api:stats: wrangler d1 execute sky-defender --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT date(at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS day, SUM(type = 'launch') AS launches, COUNT(DISTINCT device) AS players, SUM(type = 'run') AS runs, ROUND(AVG(seconds)) AS avg_sec, ROUND(AVG(score)) AS avg_score, MAX(score) AS best, ROUND(AVG(wave), 1) AS avg_wave FROM events WHERE at > (unixepoch() - 14 * 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC"
scripts.api:deaths: wrangler d1 execute sky-defender --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT wave, cause, COUNT(*) AS deaths, ROUND(AVG(seconds)) AS avg_sec FROM events WHERE type = 'run' AND at > (unixepoch() - 7 * 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY wave, cause ORDER BY wave, deaths DESC LIMIT 60"
scripts.api:weapons: wrangler d1 execute sky-defender --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT main_weapon, start_weapon, COUNT(*) AS runs, ROUND(AVG(seconds)) AS avg_sec, ROUND(AVG(score)) AS avg_score, ROUND(AVG(wave), 1) AS avg_wave FROM events WHERE type = 'run' AND main_weapon IS NOT NULL AND at > (unixepoch() - 7 * 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY main_weapon, start_weapon ORDER BY avg_sec DESC"
scripts.api:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sky-defender --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
